quests.title: Salt on the Wind
quests.summary: Catch three fish off the Hearthbay dock.
intro: You'll be the new tenant, then. Bait shop's yours till somebody says otherwise.
Rod's on the hook by the door. Your aunt's, it was. Go on, end of the dock.
Hold to cast, let go in the bright bit. Bring me three fish and I'll show you how we do things.
quests.reminder: Three fish, love. End of the dock. I'll be right here, pretending not to watch.
outro: Three! And none of them looking at you funny. Good start.
I'll buy what you catch, right here at the stall. Fair prices. Mostly fair.

quests.title: Supper for the Village
quests.summary: Sell eight fish at Mara's stall.
intro: Half the village eats what comes off this dock. Lately it's been… thin.
Sell me eight fish. The bigger the better. The odder the better, honestly.
quests.reminder: Eight fish for the stall. Bring them here and I'll do the sums.
outro: That'll feed the Pollards and then some. Here, you've earned a look at the good shelf.
And the notice board by the stall's got odd jobs, if you want more coin. Folk pay well for strange requests.

quests.title: A Proper Rod
quests.summary: Buy the Harbour Rod from Mara's shop.
intro: That driftwood stick will snap the first time something with opinions bites.
Harbour Rod. Four hundred and fifty. I'll even throw in some worms.
quests.reminder: Harbour Rod's on the good shelf. Four-fifty. I don't haggle. Much.
outro: Now you look like you mean it. Worms are in the tin. Don't open it indoors.

quests.title: Wick's Drawing
quests.summary: Catch the pink fish from Wick's drawing.
intro: Look! I drew it before I saw it. That means it's real. That's how it works.
It's pink and it bites sunsets. It lives near the cove or the Teeth. Catch it? Please?
quests.reminder: The pink one! Near the cove or the Teeth. It likes sunsets best.
outro: It looks EXACTLY like my drawing! Except it has fewer legs. I'll fix that.

quests.title: The Dark Lamp
intro: The light on Gull Point's been dark since the keeper went down. Down, I said. Not away.
A lamp like that won't take ordinary oil. It wants a light the sea made.
Lampjaw. After the sun's gone. Bring me one.
quests.reminder: Lampjaw only shows once the sun's gone. Be patient. The sea is.
outro: There. Still warm. Hold onto it, it'll want to go home.

quests.title: Relight
quests.summary: Climb the lighthouse on Gull Point and light the lamp.
intro: Up the stairs, all the way. Put the light where the light goes.
And when it catches, don't look at the water. Not straight away.
quests.reminder: I'll row you out to Gull Point when you're ready. Just say.
outro: There she is. Hearthbay's been holding its breath a long while.
You saw it, didn't you. In the water. Two of them.
Good. Then you're the keeper now. Nobody chooses it. Take the skiff, it was hers.

quests.title: A Kettle on the Shore
quests.summary: Sail the skiff out to Kettle Isle, west of the cove, and find the keeper's kettle.
intro: She's light on the helm. Push her on and she goes, let her be and she glides. Never cast till she's settled.
South-west of here there's an isle with a kettle on it. The keeper took her tea there, tides she wanted quiet.
Go and see if it's still warm. It will be. That's the part I don't care for.

objectives.label: Sail to Kettle Isle, west of the cove, and find the kettle

quests.reminder: Kettle Isle. West of the cove, out past its mouth. You'll know the beach.
outro: Warm, was it. Twelve winters on a bare rock, and warm.
Keep it. Her things go to whoever keeps the light.

quests.title: What Bites at the Teeth
quests.summary: Sail south-west to the Teeth and catch a Twofold Flounder.
intro: So he's given you the skiff. Good. It's sat at that dock like a held breath.
South-west there's three black rocks, the Teeth. Deep water. Nothing off them has reached my stall in a long while.
Bring me a Twofold Flounder. And don't let it look at you with both faces at once.

objectives.label: Catch a Twofold Flounder at the Teeth

quests.reminder: The Teeth, south-west past the sandbar. Flounder sit deep, so give it line.
outro: Oh, that's the one. Look at it. Looking at us.
My sister brought these in by the basket. I don't know why I said that. I haven't got a sister.
